hooks.command: d="$PWD"; while [ ! -f "$d/.gtt/scripts/gtt_protect.py" ] && [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ "$d" != "." ]; do d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; cd "$d" 2>/dev/null; bash .gtt/scripts/gtt-run-python.sh .gtt/scripts/gtt_protect.py hook --format antigravity; rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 2 ] && exit 2; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || echo 'GTT WARNING: the GTT pre-tool hook could not run; this call was NOT checked. The CI gate is the layer that holds.' >&2; exit 0
